The agentic economy is a financial system where AI agents autonomously hold balances, transact, and authorize payments
LI.FI: The Agentic Economy — A Deep Dive

title: The agentic economy stack has four layers: tool integration, agent communication, commerce protocols, and settlement
content:
LI.FI maps the agentic economy onto a four-layer protocol stack:

1. **Tool integration:** Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP, Nov 2024) — ~97 million monthly SDK downloads and ~5,800 active servers by Q1 2026
2. **Agent-to-agent communication:** Google's A2A protocol, donated to the Linux Foundation June 2025, 150+ supporter organizations
3. **Economic coordination:** Stripe-OpenAI's Agentic Commerce Protocol (Sep 2025) and Shopify-Google's Universal Commerce Protocol (Jan 2026)
4. **Authorization & settlement:** Google's Agents Payments Protocol (AP2) with cryptographically signed Mandates, paired with Coinbase's x402 for stablecoin settlement

**Why it matters:** each layer is already a multi-vendor standard, not a single company's product — the stack is composable the way the web stack was.

Source: LI.FI, "The Agentic Economy — A Deep Dive" (https://li.fi/knowledge-hub/the-agentic-economy-%E2%80%94-a-deep-dive).
